text: This parser patch changes UID fields/getters and replaces local-key sentinel names with ImapUid_None. It does not add token or range checks to UID conversion. The accepted FETCH path still uses strtoul and typed getters return the stored field; its later zero sentinel is a separate phase. Keep type intent distinct from validated input or a strong C++ type. No parser or protocol test ran.
title: Parser UID typing does not add numeric input validation
